title: One-step extension of rejection
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c_0,c_1,c$ be configurations on the same input, with register $r$, integer position $p$, state $s$, and input-head position $ip$. Suppose $c_0$ is obtained from $c$ by setting its state to $s$, its input-head position to $ip$, and register $r$'s head position to $p$; suppose that $P$ has no oracle call at $s$, that one step from $c_0$ yields $c_1$, and that the computation from $c_1$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$. Then the computation from $c_0$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$.
hypotheses_covered: A state $s$ and valid input-head position $ip$
$c_0$ is the specified configuration based on $c,s,ip,r,p$
There is no oracle call at state $s$
The computation from $c_1$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$
